# Which college offer will really cost less?

> Free financial aid award letter comparator. Type in each college's cost, grants, loans and work-study and see the true four-year cost, loans repaid with interest, the year-2 price jump and the grant that would match the cheapest offer. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
